mapper.select: SELECT id, template_code, template_name FROM promotion_landing_template WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id, domain_host, landing_template_id, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM promotion_domain WHERE domain_host = #{domainHost} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_domain (domain_host, landing_template_id, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{domainHost}, #{landingTemplateId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO promotion_channel (channel_code, channel_name, owner_user_id, promotion_domain_id, target_country_value, preselected_country_value, platform, is_in_app_open_allowed, is_marketing_allowed, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{channelCode}, #{channelName}, #{ownerUserId}, #{promotionDomainId}, #{targetCountry}, #{preselectedCountry}, #{platform}, #{isInAppOpenAllowed}, #{isMarketingAllowed}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO promotion_channel_tracking_config (channel_id, provider_type, tracking_id, access_token_ciphertext, encryption_key_id, token_fingerprint, lead_event_name, login_request_event_name, login_success_event_name, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{providerType}, #{trackingId}, #{accessTokenCiphertext}, #{encryptionKeyId}, #{tokenFingerprint}, #{leadEventName}, #{loginRequestEventName}, #{loginSuccessEventName}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

SELECT c.id, c.channel_name AS channelName, c.channel_code AS channelCode, c.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, c.target_country_value AS targetCountry, c.preselected_country_value AS preselectedCountry, d.landing_template_id AS landingTemplateId, t.template_name AS templateName, d.domain_host AS domainHost, c.platform, tc.tracking_id AS trackingId, tc.last_probe_status AS lastProbeStatus, c.status, c.is_in_app_open_allowed AS isInAppOpenAllowed, c.is_marketing_allowed AS isMarketingAllowed, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM promotion_channel c INNER JOIN promotion_domain d ON d.id = c.promotion_domain_id INNER JOIN promotion_landing_template t ON t.id = d.landing_template_id LEFT JOIN promotion_channel_tracking_config tc ON tc.channel_id = c.id AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
